summary: Official warnings state that Tazemetostat increases the risk of developing secondary malignancies, which are new cancers that appear after starting treatment, including various types of blood and bone marrow cancers [3]. In addition, a drug company requested the termination of all studies using this drug due to the higher risk of patients developing these new cancers [7]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a medium risk score of 63 for the liver and a low risk score of 37 for the heart [M].
